note.zh: 在修正运行环境配置后，以明确的第 2 次子尝试通过 AntiGravity CLI 1.1.13 的精确选择器 gemini-3.7-flash（High）使用仓库标准中文提示词生成，源码未经人工修改，耗时 2 分 3 秒。原生系统提示正常启用，工作区未注入 AGENTS.md、额外上下文文件、外部 Skill、插件或 MCP，外部 URL 与 Web Search 动作被阻断；由于 AntiGravity 没有可验证的内置 Skill 与上下文发现总开关，隔离状态为 partial。CLI 未回报运行时模型 ID，归因依据为已选择的精确目录项。交付修复仅将原始 HTML 通过 CDN 请求的 Three.js 0.128.0 精确内联，未修改游戏逻辑；原始归档与远端对象已保留，并通过审计 repair-artifact 路径发布。此前受基础设施配置影响的父尝试不计作模型结果。
note.en: Generated from the repository's canonical Chinese prompt after the runtime configuration was corrected, as an explicit second child attempt using AntiGravity CLI 1.1.13 with the exact gemini-3.7-flash selector (High), with unmodified source, in 2 minutes 3 seconds. The native system prompt remained enabled, no AGENTS.md, extra context files, external skills, plugins, or MCP were injected, and outbound URL and Web Search actions were blocked. Because AntiGravity has no verifiable master switch for bundled skills or context discovery, isolation is recorded as partial. The CLI did not report a runtime model ID; attribution is based on the exact selected catalog entry. The delivery-only repair precisely inlines Three.js 0.128.0, which the original HTML requested from a runtime CDN, without changing game logic; the original archive and remote object are preserved, and the repair was published through the audited repair-artifact path. The earlier parent attempt affected by infrastructure configuration is excluded from the model result.
